mechanism: Bumetanide causes volume and electrolyte depletion which enhances the hypotensive effects of benazepril (ACE inhibitor), while benazepril may reduce renal perfusion and impair bumetanide clearance.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and potassium levels; adjust bumetanide or benazepril dosing as needed; counsel on orthostatic hypotension symptoms.
